sources.title: Strength in Suffering
markers: | summary = '''Strength in Suffering''' is a passive feature that lets the wearer deal extra Force damage when below half their hit points.

summary: At half maximum HP or lower, your damaging non-cantrip spells deal 1d4 additional Force damage.

fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
